hardware: Ascend 310P3, dav-2002; physical davinci0 exposed to one benchmark container
model: fused YOLOv8s topology, 17 classes; independently supplied checkpoint, not bundled
input: same fixed [1,3,640,640] tensor quantized to FP16 in both variants
scope: full Detect forward including DFL and box decode; NMS, preprocessing, H2D and source-coordinate restoration excluded
memory_scope: parent process PSS only, excluding native child processes; 20ms startup sampler, one steady snapshot before timing; not device HBM
aggregation: headline is median of five per-round medians; pooled 505-sample medians also reported; no round or outlier discarded

native_settings.input_and_weights: FP16; HF32 flags do not change FP16 operand dtype

source_relationship: The measurement revision and release source have identical executable kernel expressions; subsequent changes add reports and correctness comments.
method: Five fresh-process rounds; 30 warmups and 101 retained synchronized wall samples per mode. Relative Thin/native order alternates. Acquisition also ran two earlier Thin implementations: odd rounds earlier-specialized, earlier-generalized, Thin, native; even rounds reverse. Only release Thin and native samples are included here. Sampler stopped before timing; no simultaneous NPU workload.
raw_data_policy: All timing samples and numeric memory/startup measurements retained for both published variants; process IDs, command lines, asset fingerprints and private filesystem metadata omitted.
